description:
Log a project decision. Appends to the decision log so future sessions can find it.

Args:
  title: Short decision title (e.g. 'Use JWT for auth')
  body: Full decision details — what was decided, why, alternatives considered
  status: Decision status — 'accepted', 'proposed', or 'superseded' (default 'accepted')
  agent: Optional writer attribution stored in frontmatter (e.g. 'codex')

Returns confirmation.
name: save_decision
